summary: Implemented the authoritative Supabase workflow/event store, deterministic inert seed/reset, guarded projections, idempotency/outbox/provider/lease state, Vault-backed one-minute Supabase Cron trigger, and reproducible portable LightGBM/calibration/SHAP artifact set.

commands: PostgreSQL 17 scratch cluster: apply core migration + seed + psql -f tests/database/launch_workflow.sql
pglast parse of both migrations, seed, and database SQL tests
tests.notes: 9 Python/database migration tests passed; the portable artifact reproduced byte-for-byte; PostgreSQL integration covered deterministic reset, immutable/ordered events, idempotency uniqueness, provider allowlists, schedule/outbox claims, safe stale-lease retry, and outcome-unknown reconciliation. Contract validation passed. The Supabase Cron migration was syntax-parsed and statically checked for its exact cadence, Vault names, bearer GET, restricted execution, and absence of embedded origins/secrets.

blockers: Docker was unavailable, so `supabase db reset` could not run against the local Supabase stack; the core migration/seed/tests passed against an isolated PostgreSQL 17 scratch cluster instead.

No controlled Supabase DEV project credentials or operator-provisioned Vault entries were available, so migrations were not pushed remotely and the live named Cron job, advisors, pg_net response, database size, and authenticated Vercel tick remain operator preflight work.
notes_for_next_agent: Backend commands should use one parameterized transaction for idempotency lookup/lock, workflow event append, projection/schedule/outbox updates, and idempotency completion. The workflow_events trigger enforces consecutive aggregate versions with SQLSTATE 40001.

The fixed finals scenario UUID is 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. `reset_finals_scenario()` is the only reset path; it restores fixed IDs/timestamps/projections and the exact inert T-3/T-1 schedule while proving no outbox, provider-attempt, or webhook state survives.

Call `try_scheduler_lock(scenario_id)` before the bounded tick, then `claim_scheduled_actions` and `claim_outbox`. `recover_stale_claims` returns internal unattempted work to pending but makes possibly accepted provider work outcome_unknown and reconciliation-required.

The cron job is `oncoready-minute-tick` at `* * * * *`; its durable command contains only `select oncoready_private.invoke_minute_tick();`. Operators must provision Vault names oncoready_tick_url and oncoready_cron_secret before applying/activating and then run tests/database/supabase_cron_preflight.sql without printing values.

The runtime ML loader must verify artifacts/ml/supportive-outreach-v1/manifest.json and every file hash, preserve the artifact feature order/missing-value routing, run golden-vector parity, and fail closed to Score unavailable on mismatch.

database_changes.live_verification: NOT_RUN: no linked controlled DEV project or Vault values; local Supabase Docker unavailable. Core SQL was verified on an isolated PostgreSQL 17 cluster.
